import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();
        
        long[][] C = new long[501][501];
        C[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        long[] w = new long[501];
        long[] dp = new long[501];
        w[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long cur = C[i-1][j-1] * w[j-1] % mod * w[i-j] % mod;
                w[i] = (w[i] + cur * (i+1)) % mod;
                long term1 = C[i-1][j-1] * ((dp[j-1] * w[i-j] % mod + w[j-1] * dp[i-j] % mod) % mod) % mod * (i+1) % mod;
                long term2 = cur * ((i-j)*(i-j+1)/2 + (j)*(j-1)/2) % mod;
                dp[i] = (dp[i] + term1 + term2) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        long[][] w2 = new long[502][502];
        long[][] dp2 = new long[502][502];
        w2[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n+1; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= Math.min(i-1, k); j++) {
                    int pi = i - j - 1;
                    int pk = k - j;
                    long cw = C[k][j];
                    w2[i][k] = (w2[i][k] + cw * w2[pi][pk] % mod * w[j] % mod) % mod;
                    dp2[i][k] = (dp2[i][k] + cw * w2[pi][pk] % mod * dp[j] + cw * dp2[pi][pk] % mod * w[j]) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp2[i][j] = (dp2[i][j] + dp2[i-1][j]) % mod;
                w2[i][j] = (w2[i][j] + w2[i-1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dp2[n+1][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
